---
name: "Feature request"
about: "Propose one useful behavior with concrete inputs and acceptance checks."
title: ""
---

## Use case / 사용 목적

What recurring data-checking task would this help? Give a small synthetic example.

## Current and proposed behavior / 현재·제안 동작

Describe what current main does and the specific behavior you propose.
A proposal is not an already-supported feature.

## Scope and acceptance checks / 범위·완료 조건

List the bounded behavior, compatibility requirements, and observable checks.
Explain any new dependency or command-line option you believe is necessary.

## Related work / 관련 작업

Link related issues or pull requests. If you intend to contribute, describe
your planned scope here so contributors can coordinate.
